title: Bounded runtime cost routing
boundary: Default off. Only a human owner or administrator can prepare and approve an explicit candidate pool. Saving or approving never starts a task.
profile: Qualification: bare_text_proxy_v1 · ordinaryToolsQualityProven: false · completeContextCaptured: false
historyCost: Reported USD is historical evidence, not a future quote, spending cap, or guarantee of ordinary tool quality.
privacy: Policy metadata is visible to authorized company owners and administrators. Do not paste private cases, inputs, outputs, prompts, or secrets here. New tasks use ordinary company visibility; private proof text is never copied.
unsupported: Only explicitly tested built-in local Claude candidates with pinned API-key credentials are supported. Missing evidence, wrong identities, unknown or unsettled costs cannot be overridden by a checkbox.
defaultOff: Runtime routing is disabled by the server feature flag. Metadata and disable controls remain available.
paused: The company is paused. Preparation, approval, new tasks and runs are blocked; you can still inspect metadata or disable the policy.
error: The request could not be verified. Refresh authorized metadata or read back the pending request before trying again.
invalid: Enter valid metadata matching the bounded policy contract. Raw text and extra fields are not accepted.
policyInput: Explicit candidate policy JSON — identifiers, hashes and thresholds only
prepared: Proposal prepared. No task or run was started.
approved: Policy approved. No task or run was started.
disabledPolicy: Future routing disabled. Existing runs were not cancelled.
disableBoundary: Disable changes future policy use only. It does not cancel an accepted run, reverse provider fees, or undo external effects.
confirmBare: I accept the limited bare-text proxy; ordinary tool quality is not proven.
confirmHistorical: I understand that historical reported USD is not a future price or spending cap.
confirmNew: I approve only new, projectless tasks and their first fresh run; no fallback to another candidate or old task.
confirmNoRun: I understand that policy approval does not start execution.
confirmAudience: I understand the policy metadata audience and ordinary task visibility.
confirmDisable: I understand that disabling does not cancel accepted runs or fees.
blocked: Evidence blocked — confirmations cannot make it eligible.
proposalExpired: This proposal is expired or no longer matches the current generation. Prepare a new proposal.
taskVisibility: This creates an ordinary company-visible task. Enter intended work, not private evaluation cases or credentials. Editing its content after binding blocks the first run.
confirmTask: I confirm that this new task may be visible to the company.
createTask: Create new bound task — do not run
taskCreated: New task bound to one candidate. Execution has not been requested.
confirmRun: Start this bound task now; provider fees and external effects may occur.
runBoundary: Running is a separate action. The server rechecks authorization, policy, evidence, configuration and budgets. Failure never switches candidates or resumes an old task.
runRequested: Run request recorded. This is not proof that the model started, consumed input or completed successfully.
unknown: The write outcome is unknown. Its request ID is retained; do not create a replacement or assume that an HTTP error means nothing happened.
unresolved: No terminal outcome is proven. The pending request is retained.
closed: The server confirmed that this request is closed without applying it.
confirmRetry: I reviewed the latest readback and authorize only the exact same request and payload.
retryUnavailable: Exact task content is not retained after leaving this view. Read back the request; do not recreate it while its outcome is unknown.
storageFailed: Recovery metadata could not be stored and verified. Mutations are blocked; keep this page open and check browser storage.
notAuthorized: Current owner or administrator access could not be verified. Private metadata is hidden.
proxyThresholdNotMet: Excluded by the bare proxy quality threshold
boundPolicyInactive: The bound policy is inactive or has changed. This task cannot switch to another candidate.
bindingUnavailable: The previous task binding could not be read. Current policy access was checked again; you can still disable future routing.
previousSessionPending: A request from your earlier sign-in is still unresolved. Readback only: its confirmations and execution intent were not transferred.
